english.note: Use this colloquial term for a player's conduct and character during a game, including whether it is good or bad.

examples.english: They don't yell at people even when they lose; their sportsmanship is pretty good.
examples.traditional: 佢輸咗都唔鬧人，球品幾好。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 syu1 zo2 dou1 m4 naau6 jan4 kau4 ban2 gei2 hou2
